content: Řɛahd n Arebbi ak-d Abram
Awarni man aya yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Abram deg ijj n řewḥiy. Inna as “War tteggʷed ca, Abram, Necc d aseřqi i cek, řmunet nnec temɣar aṭṭas d Necc.”
Uca inna Abram: “Sidi inu, SIDI, min d ayi ɣa tewced, maɣar necc ad raḥeɣ ammu břa mmi u Aliɛazir zi Dimacq ad yiři amecnaw mmi x wagřa n taddart inu?”
Inna Abram ɛawed: “Xzar, war d ayi tewcid zzariɛet, s uyenni, wenni iǧan am mmi n taddart inu, ad yiři d awrit inu!”
Uca xzar, awař n SIDI yusa-dd ɣares, inna: “War cek iwarret ca wa, maca wenni i ɣa iffɣen zzayek ad yiři d awrit nnec.”
Issuffeɣ i-t ɣar barra, inna: “Xzar ɣar ujenna, tḥesbed itran, mařa tzemmared ad ten tḥesbed!” Uca inna as: “Ammu i ɣa tiři zzariɛet nnec!”
Uca netta yumen di SIDI uca iḥseb as t-i-dd d tasegda.
Inna as ɛawed: “Necc d SIDI, wenni cek dd-yiwyen zi Ur n Ikaldaniyyen, ḥima ad ac wceɣ tammurt-a d řwart.”
Xenni netta inna: “A Sidi inu, SIDI, s minzi i ɣa ssneɣ, belli ad tt warteɣ?”
Inna as Netta: “Awi ayi-dd ict n tɛejmit n třata n iseggʷusa d ijj n iɣayḍ n třata iseggʷusa d ijj n icarri n třata iseggʷusa d ict n tejlilleḥt d ijj n wedbir d ameẓyan.”
Netta yiwi-dd ɣares marra man aya, ibḍa ten x wezyen u igga kuř azyen qibač i wenneɣni, maca war ibḍi ca ijḍaḍ.
Hwan-dd ijḍaḍ ittkeccaḍen x imurḍas, maca Abram yuẓẓeř xasen.
Ɣar uɣeǧay n tfuct, imsar aqa yusa as-dd i Abram ijj n yiḍeṣ yuǧeɣ, uca xzar, tiggʷudi d taǧest iḥedqen wḍan-dd xas.
Xenni inna i Abram: “Ssen s tidett aqa zzariɛet nnec ad tiři d tabarranect deg ict n temmurt i war iǧin nnes uca ad asen xedmen am isemɣan u nitni ad xasen ggen aɣiř arebɛa-mya n iseggʷusa.
Maca řgens umi ɣa xedmen am isemɣan, ad xasen ḥekmeɣ ɛawed, uca awarni man aya ad ffɣen s wagřa imɣar.
Ad tᵉttwassmuned ɣar řejdud nnec s řehna uca ad cek neḍřen am umeccaybu iweqqar.
Jjiř wiss arebɛa ad dd-iɛqeb danita, minzi řqedd n řmuɛṣiyyet n Imuriyyen ɛad war ikemmeř.”
Řami teɣři tfuct uca tedweř d taǧest, tuɣa din afarran iddexxnen u iɛdu ijj n weṣfeḍ n tmessi jar izeynan nni.
Deg wass nni nnit igga SIDI ijj n Řɛahd ak-d Abram, inna: “I zzariɛet nnec umi wciɣ tammurt-a zeg iɣzar n Miṣra ař iɣzar ameqqran, iɣzar n Lfuraṭ:
tammurt n Iqiniyyen, Iqeniziyyen, Iqadmiyyen,
Iḥittiyyen, Ifirziyyen, Irafawiyyen,
Imuriyyen, ayt n Kenɛan, Igirgaciyyen d Iyibusiyyen.”

footnotes.text: Aliɛazir- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘wenni ɣar iǧa Arebbi d amɛawen nnes’ niɣ ‘wenni umi iwca Arebbi afus’.
iḥesb as t-i-dd d tasegda- niɣ ‘igga as t i netta d tasegda’.

afessar - řami ggin tnayen n ijeǧiden zic ijj n řɛahd di Ccarq-Ameřwasu ksin nitni ijj n umeddar i tɣarṣt, bḍan t d izeynan uca ssarsen azyen ɣar ijj n uɣezdis u azyen ɣar ijj n uɣezdis nneɣni. Xenni tuɣa x ujeǧid nni tuɣa d amuqřiř zzaysen ad yuyur di řwest n tnayen n iziynan am iqqar aqa ajeǧid wenni d ameqqran zzaysen ɣares řḥeqq ḥima ad kides igg amecnaw min igga ak-d umuddar i umi ɣarṣen, mařa netta war ikemmeř řɛahd i igga akides (xzar Irm. 34:18-20). Deg wawařen-a nettwařa aqa Arebbi wenni d ameqqran x Ibrahim, tuɣa iggur di řwest n izeynan n umeddar di ṣṣifet n wesfeḍ am tuɣa Ibrahim ittbedda ɣar uɣezdis. Man aya ixs ad yini aqa Arebbi s Yixef nnes d Netta i iqeḍɛen řɛahd ak-d Ibrahim minzi Arebbi ittḥinna x bnadem, issen bnadem war izemmar ad ikemmeř uřa d ijj n řɛahd akides. Bnadem izemmar mɣir ad ittwassenjem xmi i ɣa yamen di Řɛahd i igga Arebbi di Mmis, ixs ad yini di Lmasiḥ wenni iwcin Ixef nnes d tɣarṣt i ddnub n iwdan.
